# Homer Sedighi D.M.D, Pediatric Dentistry

> > A Chesterfield, MO pediatric dental practice specializing in child-friendly care, preventive dentistry, and specialized treatments for infants and children with special needs.

Dr. Homer Sedighi and Dr. Jessica Martin lead a dedicated pediatric dentistry practice focused on creating positive dental experiences for children from infancy through adolescence. The practice emphasizes preventive care, advanced technology, and community involvement in the greater St. Louis area.

## Dental Services

- [Our Services](https://www.kidsdentistry.com/our-services.html): Comprehensive pediatric dental services including emergency and sedation care
- [Preventive Dentistry](https://www.kidsdentistry.com/preventive-dentistry.html): Preventive care including checkups, sealants, fluoride, and screenings
- [Kids' Dental Checkups & Cleanings](https://www.kidsdentistry.com/kids-dental-checkups-and-cleanings.html): Guide to routine dental checkups and cleanings for children
- [Dental Sealants](https://www.kidsdentistry.com/dental-sealants.html): Information on dental sealants for cavity prevention in children
- [Fluoride Treatment](https://www.kidsdentistry.com/fluoride-treatment.html): Fluoride treatment options for cavity and tooth decay prevention
- [Lip & Tongue Tie Treatment](https://www.kidsdentistry.com/lip-and-tongue-tie-treatment.html): Frenectomy procedure for lip and tongue tie treatment in infants
